title: Klients Map Popup Becomes One Tab, J/K Flips Leads | vitalii.no
description:
Working through a list of candidate businesses meant constantly switching views just to see one lead's information. Klient's map was the entry point, but a business's actual data — stage, contacts, next step, samples — was split across a cramped map popup and a separate 'Analiz' tab.

I added a new 'Klient' tab as the default view in public/index.html: a filterable sidebar list (search, kommune, status, category, content-saturation buckets, two sort orders) next to one large client card that merges what used to be the map popup and the analysis tab into one place. J and K jump to the next and previous client in the filtered list, and old map and analysis links redirect to the same card. On the data side, a quick scan can now download up to 16 of a business's own content photos — skipping logos, tiny images, and duplicates — and a Claude-quota pause that used to block all runner jobs now only blocks full analyses, since scan jobs run with no AI call at all.

A business's full picture now lives in one card reachable with two keys, instead of two tabs and a popup, with up to 16 real photos pulled in automatically per lead.
